title: 25艘新船：只定10艘，为何留15艘选择权？
speaker: Martin Fluegaard

segments.en: So with these profits that you've banked and given that backdrop, what are your plans and also, of course, the high fuel costs, I know you've had some renewables as far as changing out some of the less efficient ships, what's your fleet expansion plans right now?
segments.zh: 在盈利和当前背景下，你们的计划是什么？高燃油成本下，更换低效船舶，船队扩张计划如何？

segments.en: So today we have a pipeline of 25 ships, and ten of those are new buildings which will be delivered to 28 and 29, six of them in China and four in Japan, and top of that, the remaining 15 ships are optional ships that we either have option at the shipyards or we have options for buying ships that we have taken on charter.
segments.zh: 目前我们有25艘船的储备，其中10艘是新造船，将在2028-29年交付，6艘在中国，4艘在日本。其余15艘是期权船，我们可以在船厂或租约中行使选择权。

segments.en: We like the optionality, especially in a market today where the volatility, and there's a cyclical business as well, so we feel we are very well positioned, 25 ships in the pipeline but only committed to ten of them the rest of the options.
segments.zh: 我们喜欢这种灵活性，尤其是在波动和周期性的市场中。我们定位很好，25艘船中只承诺10艘，其余是期权。
